description: This file implements a screen recording service for macOS, utilizing AVFoundation and ScreenCaptureKit. It defines a `ScreenRecordService` class for initiating and managing screen recordings, including handling errors, configuration, and output file management. It also includes a `StreamRecorder` class that manages AVAssetWriter setup, sample buffer handling for video and audio, and finishing the recording process asynchronously.

classes.name: ScreenRecordService
classes.description: A final class providing an asynchronous method to record the screen with optional audio, handling configuration, error management, and output saving.

classes.name: StreamRecorder
classes.description: A private final class managing the AVAssetWriter setup, sample buffer processing for video and audio, and finalizing the recording process asynchronously.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Initiates a screen recording session with specified options such as screen index, duration, FPS, audio inclusion, and output path, returning the saved file path and audio presence status.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes the recording asynchronously, ensuring all buffered media data is properly finalized and the file is correctly written.
